name: try except else finally
finally runs and overrides return
code:
def g():
    try:
        return 1
    finally:
        return 2
def h():
    out = []
    try:
        out.append('t')
        return 'ret'
    finally:
        out.append('f')
print(g())
print(h())

name: short circuit side effects
code:
calls = []
def t(v):
    calls.append(v)
    return v
r1 = t(False) and t('never')
r2 = t(True) or t('never')
r3 = t(0) or t('fallback')
r4 = t(1) and t('kept')
print(r1, r2, r3, r4, calls)
